what.text: This page follows refugees from Mali living in Mauritania.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 300192 Malian refugees in Mauritania, 57.8% of all Malian refugees and more than in any other host country.
Niger and Burkina Faso host the next largest numbers.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Mali from 2012 to 2025, at war level in 2022 and 2025, with groups including Ansar Dine, AQIM, MUJAO and JNIM.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2017 to 2025, and over the government and Azawad territory with the FLA from 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's figure for Mauritania rose from 153974 at the end of 2024 to 300192 at the end of 2025, its highest.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025; earlier big changes came in most years from 1991 to 1998.
Returns from Mauritania to Mali were highest in 1996 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in Mauritania only.
Gender and age are known for only part of this group.
The sources don't say which routes people took or where in Mauritania they live.
